top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall on Inflation Worry as Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A record-breaking run in stocks hit a wall as higher oil prices lifted bond yields, stoking concerns that potential inflationary pressures could trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: European Bank Stocks Sink Toward Lowest Since July as Bonds Fall
top_signals.summary: A selloff in shares of European banks resumed on Wednesday, with the likes of Societe Generale SA and Deutsche Bank AG tumbling more than 5%, as mounting fears over political turmoil sent bond yields higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Why High Bond Yields Aren’t Sinking Stocks
top_signals.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield, the most important number in global finance, has broken through to its highest level since 2002. Bond yields are assumed to have an inverse relationship with stocks, so a move of this magnitude should be a problem for equities. But it hasn’t been, and Bloomberg Opinion columnist John Authers explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Police in India Block Voter-Roll Protest for Second Day in Delhi
top_signals.summary: Police in India’s capital detained opposition leader Rahul Gandhi for a second day as lawmakers staged an unannounced protest march demanding the resignation of the country’s chief election official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Russian cyberattacks against UK are 'Putin Tax' costing $3.3 billion, says lawmaker
top_signals.summary: A report by a Labour MP and an academic argues that if the British public cannot see what Russian activity costs, it cannot weigh that burden against the cost of defending against it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
